# Create the Event Logger
	logger_name = gateway.logger.tag_path_to_logger(tagPath)  # Convert the tag path to a logger name
	logger = gateway.logger.create_logger(logger_name)  # Create the logger using the logger name

	try:
		last_value = previousValue.value # Get the last value of the tag
		tag_value = currentValue.value  # Get the current value of the tag
		tag_quality = str(currentValue.quality)  # Get the quality of the tag
	
		# Check if the tag has good quality, and is not None
		if tag_quality == "Good" and tag_value is not None:

			# Check if the tag has actually changed
			if last_value <> tag_value:
			
				tagPaths = ["[.]Value.engHigh"]
				values = [	tag_value]
				system.tag.writeAsync(tagPaths, values)
			
	except Exception as e:
		# Log an error message if an exception occurs
		logger.error("An error occurred: {}".format(e))
